facts.fact: Statistics Botswana states that the Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs, through its Department of Civil and National Registration, operates the registration offices and holds the Births and Deaths Registration System records from which the report is compiled (no date given for the statement; the report's August 2026 date is used).

Statistics Botswana describes the Births and Deaths Registration System as the national system registering births, stillbirths and deaths, the primary data source for the 49,180 births and 14,070 deaths registered in 2024.

Statistics Botswana describes the BDRS as a 'partially automated and decentralized' system designed to give real-time vital statistics and integrated with the National Identification System, which assigns a birth registration number at birth, an arrangement introduced in 2003; it does not say in terms where the record is keyed (no date given for the present state; the report's August 2026 date is used).

Statistics Botswana states that the Department of Civil and National Registration currently operates 35 district registration offices and 17 on-site registration points at named hospitals and clinics, without saying how many of them enter records in the BDRS (the report's August 2026 date is used).
